# Celularity and Vesalius Longevity Labs Sign Exclusive Collaboration for Peptual® Peptide APIs Manufactured in the United States


By[Celularity Inc.](https://celularity.com/author/celularitynew/)


in[Press Releases](https://celularity.com/category/press-releases/)


## Celularity to serve as the exclusive partner for the finish manufacturing of Vesalius’s Peptual peptide APIs, supporting Vesalius’s expansion into pharmaceutical ingredient supply


## Collaboration advances Celularity’s regenerative longevity vision and creates an opportunity to expand revenue through its U.S. manufacturing infrastructure and technical expertise


FLORHAM PARK, N.J. & SCOTTSDALE, Ariz.–([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )–Celularity Inc. (Nasdaq: CELU) (“Celularity”), a longevity-focused regenerative and cellular medicine company, and Vesalius Longevity Labs Inc. (“Vesalius”), a leading, global peptide and longevity brand, today announced that they have entered into an exclusive manufacturing agreement to establish a dedicated, first-of-its-kind, U.S. final stage API manufacturing and supply platform for Vesalius’s Peptual-branded active pharmaceutical ingredients (“APIs”).


The collaboration expands Celularity’s regenerative longevity platform by applying Celularity’s U.S.-based manufacturing infrastructure and technical capabilities to support the development of Vesalius’s Peptual **®** -branded peptide APIs at its Florham Park, New Jersey facility. It builds on Celularity’s experience manufacturing complex biologics to current good manufacturing practice (“cGMP”) standards, extending those capabilities into peptide API manufacturing while supporting its broader vision of advancing regenerative longevity.


Under the collaboration, Celularity will perform downstream purification, processing, analytical testing and manufacturing activities using supplier-provided bulk peptide material. The work is intended to establish peptide-specific manufacturing processes that satisfy cGMP requirements, supported by defined product specifications, documented sourcing and lot-level traceability. The collaboration is intended to position the parties to respond to potential regulatory developments affecting peptide compounding. If and when the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (“FDA”), following its consideration of recommendations from the Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee (“PCAC”), adds covered peptide substances and forms to its list of bulk drug substances that may be used in compounding under federal law, the parties intend to supply eligible Peptual-branded APIs to appropriately licensed U.S. compounding pharmacies. The collaboration will not involve manufacturing GLP-1 receptor agonists or other weight-loss peptides, as these products are excluded from Vesalius’s business model.


“Peptides represent an important category of products which can work to augment the clinical utility of conventional therapeutics, and we believe can complement our regenerative cellular products,” said Robert J. Hariri, M.D., Ph.D., Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Celularity. “We have invested in a purpose-built U.S. facility and assembled a team with experience manufacturing complex medicines. As such, our collaboration with Vesalius represents an important business opportunity for Celularity and a practical extension of our regenerative longevity strategy.”


The collaboration comes amid regulatory scrutiny of the quality and provenance of imported pharmaceutical ingredients. The FDA has highlighted concerns about peptide APIs from unverified foreign sources and has separately urged compounding pharmacies to verify their ingredient suppliers, understand the testing performed and identify the original API manufacturer. Celularity and Vesalius believe these concerns create an imperative for a domestic manufacturing platform to strengthen pharmaceutical supply-chain resilience and U.S. national health preparedness. By bringing key downstream manufacturing activities onshore, the collaboration is intended to establish a more transparent path from bulk peptide material through final API release.


“We selected Celularity because its facility, technical personnel and experience manufacturing complex biological products provide a strong foundation for our peptide API sourcing plans,” said Pradeep Albert, CEO of Vesalius. “Celularity’s capabilities complement our Peptual platform and commercialization strategy. Together, we aim to establish a U.S. domestic supply platform supported by documented manufacturing processes, defined quality specifications and traceability from supplier inputs through final API release.”


For patients and prescribing physicians, uncertainty about an ingredient’s origin, identity and purity raises practical questions about what is being supplied and the evidence supporting its quality. Meaningful transparency requires documentation connecting each lot to its original source, the manufacturing controls applied and the testing supporting its release. The parties intend to build that accountability into the planned platform, supporting informed sourcing decisions by pharmacies and providing a clearer basis for peptide use from prescribing physicians and their patients.


“The healthcare community deserves transparency about where the ingredients in medications originate and how their quality has been evaluated,” said Micheal Roizen,M.D., former head of Wellness at Cleveland Clinic and Chief Scientific Advisor at Vesalius. “When the original manufacturer is unclear or testing records are incomplete, physicians and patients are left with questions that should be answered before a product is used. Vesalius’s collaboration with Celularity is intended to bring greater visibility and accountability to that supply chain. That is an important foundation for responsible progress in peptide medicine.”


**Regulatory Notice**


The peptides and APIs described in this release are not FDA-approved drug products. Compounded drugs are not FDA-approved and are not reviewed by FDA for safety, effectiveness or manufacturing quality before marketing. FDA establishment registration, facility inspection, advisory committee consideration or recommendations, cGMP terminology, a certificate of analysis or domestic manufacture does not constitute FDA approval or endorsement of a substance, API, compounded drug, manufacturer or pharmacy. Execution of the collaboration agreement and completion of development or qualification activities do not themselves authorize commercial release, distribution or use of any peptide API. Availability is subject to applicable law, FDA policy and local jurisdictional requirements.


**About Vesalius Longevity Labs**


Vesalius Longevity Labs is a longevity science and regenerative health platform focused on peptides, biologics, preventative healthcare and performance optimization. Vesalius operates a scalable B2Doctor2Consumer ecosystem designed to support healthcare providers, telehealth infrastructure, product fulfillment and advanced longevity therapeutics across global markets. Vesalius’s expanding ecosystem includes peptide therapeutics, regenerative medicine initiatives, royalty-generating biologics partnerships and advanced provider enablement technologies designed to support the future of personalized health and wellness.

**About Celularity**


Celularity Inc. (Nasdaq: CELU) is a longevity-focused regenerative and cellular medicine company developing and manufacturing allogeneic and autologous cell therapies and biomaterials. Celularity’s regenerative longevity vision centers on advancing technologies intended to address aging and age-related conditions and extend healthspan. Its purpose-built facility in Florham Park, New Jersey supports manufacturing, research and biobanking activities. Celularity also pursues contract development and manufacturing opportunities that apply its infrastructure and technical expertise to third-party programs.
